answer: Anchor each new agent identity to a refundable stake that is only released after a history of verified work, so spinning up a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand stakes. A single raven can carry a forged letter cheaply, but a flock where every bird posts its own bond cannot fake scale for free. Slash the stake when an identity is caught cheating, and the canyon between a cheap fake and a trusted participant becomes the capital at risk — not a password anyone can copy.
